# Retention proposal v2

This later proposal is candidate evidence, not an accepted contract. At
`change-request-2026-09-01.pdf` section 2, dated 2026-09-01, it proposes
reducing retention to **14 days**.

It conflicts with the still-current signed agreement in
[[docs/reference/requirements/sources/policy-v1|SRC-A05-V1]]. Record the conflict and
route the decision for review; do not silently promote this proposal.
